  34  def is_aware(datetime: dt.datetime) -> bool:
  35      return (
  36          datetime.tzinfo is not None and datetime.tzinfo.utcoffset(datetime) is not None
  37      )
  38  
  39  
  40  def from_timestamp(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  41      if value is True or value is False:
  42          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  43      value = float(value)
  44      if value < 0:
  45          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  46  
  47      # Load a timestamp with utc as timezone to prevent using system timezone.
  48      # Then set timezone to None, to let the Field handle adding timezone info.
  49      try:
  50          return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=dt.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
  51      except OverflowError as exc:
  52          raise ValueError("Timestamp is too large") from exc
  53      except OSError as exc:
  54          raise ValueError("Error converting value to datetime") from exc
  55  
  56  
  57  def from_timestamp_ms(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  58      if value is True or value is False:
  59          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  60      value = float(value)
  61      return from_timestamp(value / 1000)

  69          value = value.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)

  88          >>> pluck(dlist, 'id')
  89          [1, 2]

  97  def get_value(obj, key: str, default=missing):
  98      """Helper for pulling a keyed value off various types of objects. Fields use
  99      this method by default to access attributes of the source object. For object `x`
 100      and attribute `i`, this method first tries to access `x[i]`, and then falls back to
 101      `x.i` if an exception is raised.
 102  
 103      .. warning::
 104          If an object `x` does not raise an exception when `x[i]` does not exist,
 105          `get_value` will never check the value `x.i`. Consider overriding
 106          `marshmallow.fields.Field.get_value` in this case.
 107      """
 108      if "." in key:
 109          for k in key.split("."):
 110              obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, k, default)
 111      else:
 112          obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default)
 113      return obj

 115  
 116  def _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default):
 117      if not hasattr(obj, "__getitem__"):
 118          return getattr(obj, key, default)
 119  
 120      try:
 121          return obj[key]
 122      except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError):
 123          return getattr(obj, key, default)

 126  def set_value(dct: dict[str, typing.Any], key: str, value: typing.Any):
 127      """Set a value in a dict. If `key` contains a '.', it is assumed
 128      to be a path (i.e. dot-delimited string) to the value's location.
 129  
 130      ::
 131  
 132          >>> d = {}
 133          >>> set_value(d, 'foo.bar', 42)
 134          >>> d
 135          {'foo': {'bar': 42}}
 136      """
 137      if "." in key:
 138          head, rest = key.split(".", 1)
 139          target = dct.setdefault(head, {})
 140          if not isinstance(target, dict):
 141              raise ValueError(
 142                  f"Cannot set {key} in {head} due to existing value: {target}"
 143              )
 144          set_value(target, rest, value)
 145      else:
 146          dct[key] = value

 148  
 149  def callable_or_raise(obj):
 150      """Check that an object is callable, else raise a :exc:`TypeError`."""
 151      if not callable(obj):
 152          raise TypeError(f"Object {obj!r} is not callable.")
 153      return obj

 156  def timedelta_to_microseconds(value: dt.timedelta) -> int:
 157      """Compute the total microseconds of a timedelta.
 158  
 159      https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.13.1/Lib/_pydatetime.py#L805-L807
 160      """
 161      return (value.days * (24 * 3600) + value.seconds) * 1000000 + value.microseconds
